title: Resolution urging Albany to expand state housing voucher program
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass A.10992/S.9430-A, which would let people at risk of losing a federal rental subsidy qualify for priority under the state's Housing Access Voucher Program, not just those who are homeless. The bill would also change unit inspection rules so local administrators inspect units when a housing assistance contract begins, instead of requiring federal housing choice inspection standards. It responds to the planned end of the federal Emergency Housing Voucher program, which currently supports over 6,700 households through NYCHA and HPD in New York City.
